item.title: Mastering Simplification: The Art of Focus, Leverage, and Resilience
item.description: Overview of Simplification Simplification is a core practice in the era of Moore’s Law. It emphasizes improving efficiency, focusing on critical issues, and discovering more valuable solutions in complex and dynamic environments. Part One: Classic Simplification 1. Focus on the Primary Contradiction Core Philosophy Select “the most important issue” from many and focus on solving it rather than spreading attention too thin. Pitfalls of Multiple Objectives: Chasing Ease, Ignoring Importance: “Ease” is viewed from a personal perspective, while “importance” is evaluated from a third-party value perspective.

item.title: Reading Notes on *Deng Xiaoping and the Transformation of China*
item.description: Crossing the River by Feeling the Stones In 1978, there was no clear blueprint for achieving national strength and wealth. However, Deng Xiaoping had two critical realizations for moving forward: Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan were experiencing rapid development. Their paths could not be entirely copied. Key approaches: Gradually establishing various systems instead of immediately opening markets. Encouraging cadres to broaden their horizons and learn from successful experiences worldwide. item.description: 1. Fundamentals of Global Expansion Register a US company, obtain an EIN, open a Stripe account, and set up a Mercury Bank account for $193 Step 1: Registering a US Company I chose Wyoming for registration because it offers no corporate or personal income tax and is open to all nationalities. Visit Wyoming Agents. Fill out the required basic information. For company type, select LLC for individuals or small organizations. If you need funding, choose CORP.
